words.ex: They learned about cultural traditions during the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在旅行中了解了文化传统。
words.en: Relating to the ideas, customs, and social behavior of a society.

words.ex: The old temple is a relic from ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的寺庙是来自古代的遗迹。
words.en: An object surviving from an earlier time, especially one of historical or sentimental interest.

words.ex: Rare birds can be seen in this forest.
words.ex_cn: 这种森林里可以看到稀有的鸟类。
words.en: Something that is rare is not common and is therefore interesting or valuable.

words.tr: adj. 有价值的；贵重的；值钱的；
words.ex: This old book is valuable to historians.
words.ex_cn: 这本旧书对历史学家来说很有价值。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as valuable, you mean that they are very useful and helpful.

words.tr: v. 幸存；生存；存活；艰难挺过；
words.ex: He survived the accident with minor injuries.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中幸存下来，只有轻微受伤。
words.en: If you survive in a dangerous situation, you continue to live or exist in spite of it.

words.ex: She put flowers in a vase on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她把花放在桌子上的花瓶里。
words.en: A vase is a container, often used for holding cut flowers. It can be made from a variety of materials, including glass, ceramics, and metals.

words.ex: The Tang dynasty was famous for its poetry and art.
words.ex_cn: 唐朝以诗歌和艺术而闻名。
words.en: A dynasty is a series of rulers of a country who all belong to the same family.

words.tr: phrase. 泰姬陵（印度著名白色大理石陵墓，世界文化遗产）
words.ex: He visited the Taj Mahal last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年参观了泰姬陵。
words.en: The Taj Mahal is an ivory-white marble mausoleum on the south bank of the Yamuna river in the Indian city of Agra. It was commissioned in 1632 by the Mughal emperor, Shah Jahan, to house the tomb of his favorite wife, Mumtaz Mahal.

words.tr: n. 象牙；象牙色 adj. 象牙色的
words.ex: The old piano has ivory keys.
words.ex_cn: 这架旧钢琴有象牙键。
words.en: Ivory is a hard, white material from the tusks and teeth of animals, which is used to make or decorate objects.

words.ex: The boy drew a big dragon on his notebook.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在他的笔记本上画了一条大龙。
words.en: A mythical monster like a giant reptile. In European tradition, it is typically fire-breathing and tends to symbolize chaos or evil, whereas in East Asia it is usually a beneficent symbol of fertility, associated with water and the heavens.

words.ex: She wore a necklace made of amber.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了一条琥珀制成的项链。
words.en: Amber is a hard, translucent, yellowish-brown substance that is used for making jewelry or other objects. It is formed from the resin of ancient trees.

words.ex: He is in search of a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他正在寻找一份新工作。
words.en: If you are in search of something, you are looking for it.

words.tr: 专有名词，指普鲁士国王腓特烈·威廉一世（1688–1740），以建立强大的普鲁士军队和节俭治国著称
words.ex: Frederick William I was a strict king of Prussia.
words.ex_cn: 腓特烈·威廉一世是普鲁士的一位严厉国王。
words.en: King of Prussia (1688-1740), known for his military reforms and the 'Soldier King' nickname.

words.tr: n. 普鲁士（历史上位于欧洲中北部的一个国家）
words.ex: Prussia was a powerful kingdom in Europe.
words.ex_cn: 普鲁士是欧洲的一个强大王国。
words.en: A historical region and former kingdom in north-central Europe, which played a significant role in the history of Germany and Europe.

words.ex: The magic show amazed the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演让孩子们感到惊奇。
words.en: To amaze someone means to surprise them very much.

words.tr: adj. 令人惊异的；令人惊叹的； v. “amaze”的现在分词；
words.ex: The view from the mountain is amazing.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色令人惊异。
words.en: If something is amazing, it is very surprising and makes you feel pleasure or admiration.

words.tr:
v. 选择；挑选；
adj. 精心挑选的；
words.ex: He will select the best candidate for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他将选择最适合这份工作的人。
words.en: If you select something, you choose it from a number of things of the same kind.

words.ex: She put honey on her toast.
words.ex_cn: 她在吐司上涂了蜂蜜。
words.en: Honey is a sweet, sticky, yellowish-brown fluid made by bees and other insects from nectar collected from flowers.

words.tr:
n. 设计；图案；花样；企图；图谋；
v. 设计；计划；谋划；构思；
words.ex: The dress has a beautiful design.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子有一个美丽的设计。
words.en: To design something means to plan and make a detailed drawing of it, or to plan and create something in a skillful or artistic way.

words.tr:
v. 想要；
adj. 花哨的；昂贵的；
n. 爱好；
words.ex: I fancy a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我想要一杯茶。
words.en: If you describe something as fancy, you mean that it is special, unusual, or elaborate, often because it has a lot of decoration or is very expensive.

words.tr: n. 风格；方式；样式；文体；
words.ex: Her dress has a unique style.
words.ex_cn: 她的裙子有一种独特的风格。
words.en: A particular kind, sort, or type, as with reference to form, appearance, or character.

words.ex: We decorate the room for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我们为派对装饰房间。
words.en: To make something look more attractive by putting things on it or around it.

words.ex: She wore a beautiful jewel on her finger.
words.ex_cn: 她手指上戴着一颗漂亮的珠宝。
words.en: A jewel is a precious stone that is used to decorate valuable objects such as rings or necklaces.

words.ex: The artist painted a beautiful landscape.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家画了一幅美丽的风景画。
words.en: An artist is someone who draws or paints pictures or creates sculptures as a job or hobby.

words.ex: This book belongs to me.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我。
words.en: If something belongs to you, you own it or it is yours.

words.ex: This book belongs to me.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我。
words.en: If something belongs to you, you own it or it is yours.

words.tr: phrase. 彼得大帝（俄罗斯帝国沙皇，1682-1725年在位，推行西化改革，使俄国成为欧洲强国）
words.ex: Peter the Great made Russia strong and modern.
words.ex_cn: 彼得大帝使俄罗斯变得强大和现代化。
words.en: Peter the Great was a Russian czar who ruled from 1682 until his death in 1725. He is known for his extensive reforms aimed at modernizing Russia and for founding the city of Saint Petersburg.

words.ex: I helped him, and he gave me a gift in return.
words.ex_cn: 我帮了他，他送了我一份礼物作为回报。
words.en: If you do something in return for what someone else has done for you, you do it because they did that thing for you.

words.ex: The czar ruled Russia with strong power.
words.ex_cn: 沙皇以强大的权力统治俄罗斯。
words.en: A czar is a male monarch or emperor, especially one of the former emperors of Russia.

words.ex: The troop marched into the town at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 部队在黎明时分进入城镇。
words.en: A troop is a group of soldiers or a large group of people or animals.

words.tr: phrase. 圣彼得堡（俄罗斯城市）
words.ex: St. Petersburg is known for its rich history and beautiful architecture.
words.ex_cn: 圣彼得堡以其丰富的历史和美丽的建筑而闻名。
words.en: A major city in Russia, known for its cultural heritage and historical significance.

words.ex: The reception at the hotel was very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的接待非常友好。
words.en: The act of receiving or being received, especially in a formal or official context.

words.tr: 专有名词. 叶卡捷琳娜二世（俄罗斯帝国女皇，1762–1796年在位）
words.ex: Catherine II, also known as Catherine the Great, was a powerful leader of Russia.
words.ex_cn: 叶卡捷琳娜二世，也被称为叶卡捷琳娜大帝，是俄罗斯的强大领导者。
words.en: Catherine II, also known as Catherine the Great, was the most renowned and the longest-ruling female leader of Russia, reigning from 1762 until 1796. She came to power following a coup d'état that overthrew her husband, Peter III. Under her reign, Russia was revitalized; it grew larger and stronger and was recognized as one of the great powers of Europe.

words.tr: phrase. 处于战争状态的；交战的
words.ex: The two countries are at war.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家处于战争状态。
words.en: Engaged in a war or conflict.

words.ex: Please remove the trash from the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 请把厨房的垃圾去掉。
words.en: To take something or someone away from a place or off a surface.

words.ex: He has less than five apples.
words.ex_cn: 他不到五个苹果。
words.en: If something is less than a particular amount, it is not as much as that amount.

words.ex: He sat on a wooden chair.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在一张木制椅子上。
words.en: Made of wood; lacking ease or grace.

words.tr:
n. 疑问；疑惑；
v. 怀疑；拿不准；
words.ex: I have doubt about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我对这个答案有疑问。
words.en: If you have doubt or doubts about something, you feel uncertain about it and do not know whether it is true or possible. If you say that something is beyond doubt, you mean that it is definitely true.

words.tr: n. 哥尼斯堡（德国城市，现为俄罗斯的加里宁格勒）
words.ex: Königsberg was a city in the past, now it is called Kaliningrad.
words.ex_cn: 柯尼斯堡是一座过去的城市，现在叫加里宁格勒。
words.en: Königsberg is the German name for the city now known as Kaliningrad, located in Russia. It was historically the capital of East Prussia.

words.tr: phrase. 波罗的海（位于北欧的海域）
words.ex: The fisherman sails on the Baltic Sea.
words.ex_cn: 渔夫在波罗的海上航行。
words.en: The Baltic Sea is a sea of the Atlantic Ocean, enclosed by Scandinavia, Finland, the Baltic countries, and the North European Plain.

words.tr: n. 谜；难以理解的事物；
words.ex: The mystery of the missing key puzzled everyone.
words.ex_cn: 丢失的钥匙这个谜题让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: Something that is difficult or impossible to understand or explain.

words.ex: He is a former teacher who now works as a writer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名以前的老师，现在是一名作家。
words.en: Former is used to describe someone who used to have a particular job, position, or role, but no longer has it.

words.tr:
adj. 值得的；有…价值；
n. 价值；
words.ex: This book is worth reading.
words.ex_cn: 这本书值得读。
words.en: If something is worth a particular amount of money, it can be sold for that amount or is considered to have that value.

words.ex: They will rebuild the house after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他们将在风暴后重建这座房子。
words.en: To rebuild something means to build it again after it has been damaged or destroyed.

words.ex: He bought fresh vegetables from the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他从本地市场买了新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: Something that is local relates to a particular area or to the area where you live.

words.ex: The two houses are apart by fifty meters.
words.ex_cn: 这两所房子相隔五十米。
words.en: If people or things are apart, they are separated by a distance.

words.ex: He took apart the clock to see how it works.
words.ex_cn: 他把钟表拆开来看它是如何工作的。
words.en: To separate something into its different parts, especially in order to repair it or to understand how it works.

words.tr: n. 列宁格勒（俄罗斯西北部城市，现称圣彼得堡）
words.ex: He visited Leningrad in 1985.
words.ex_cn: 他于1985年访问了列宁格勒。
words.en: A former name for the city of Saint Petersburg in Russia, used during the Soviet era.

words.tr: n. 绘画；油画； v. 刷油漆；用颜料画；“paint”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves painting in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间绘画。
words.en: A painting is a picture which someone has painted.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A castle is a large building or group of buildings fortified against attack with thick walls, battlements, towers, and in many cases a moat.

words.tr: phrase. 温莎城堡（英国王室的官方居所之一，位于英格兰伯克郡温莎镇）
words.ex: She visited Windsor Castle last summer.
words.ex_cn: 她去年夏天参观了温莎城堡。
words.en: Windsor Castle is a royal residence at Windsor in the English county of Berkshire. It is notable for its long association with the English and later British royal family and for its architecture.

words.ex: The doctor ran a trial to test the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生进行了试验来测试这种新药。
words.en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

words.ex: The eyewitness saw the accident happen.
words.ex_cn: 目击者看到了事故的发生。
words.en: An eyewitness is a person who has seen something happen and can give a first-hand description of it.

words.ex: The police found evidence at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了证据。
words.en: Evidence is anything that you see, experience, read, or are told that causes you to believe that something is true or has really happened.

words.tr: phrase. 扬·哈谢克（捷克作家，以讽刺小说《好兵帅克》闻名）
words.ex: Jan Hasek is a Czech writer.
words.ex_cn: 扬·哈塞克是一位捷克作家。
words.en: A surname, possibly of Czech origin, meaning 'God is gracious'.

words.tr: phrase. 捷克共和国（东欧国家）
words.ex: He traveled to the Czech Republic last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了捷克共和国。
words.en: A country in Central Europe, known for its rich history, cultural heritage, and architectural beauty.

words.ex: The bomb will explode at noon.
words.ex_cn: 炸弹将在中午爆炸。
words.en: If an object explodes, it bursts loudly and with great force, often causing damage or injury.

words.ex: The entrance to the building is on the left.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的入口在左边。
words.en: An entrance is a way into a place, such as a door or gate. It can also refer to the act of entering a place or the right to enter.

words.tr: 专有名词，人名，汉斯·布劳恩（常见于德语姓名）
words.ex: Hans Braun teaches math at a high school.
words.ex_cn: 汉斯·布劳恩在一所高中教数学。
words.en: A surname, of German origin, meaning 'brown' or referring to someone with brown hair.

words.ex: The sailor fixed the rope on the boat.
words.ex_cn: 水手修理了船上的绳子。
words.en: A sailor is a person who works on a ship as a member of its crew.

words.tr:
n. 洗涤槽；水槽；
v. （使）沉没；
words.ex: The dirty dishes are in the sink.
words.ex_cn: 脏盘子在水槽里。
words.en: If a boat sinks, or if something sinks it, it disappears below the surface of a mass of water.

words.tr: 专有名词，人名，安娜·彼得罗夫（常见于俄语姓名的英文转写）
words.ex: Anna Petrov solves algebra problems every day.
words.ex_cn: 安娜·彼得罗夫每天解代数题。
words.en: A surname, of Russian origin, meaning 'rock' or 'stone'.

words.ex: The maid cleans the house every morning.
words.ex_cn: 女仆每天早上打扫房子。
words.en: A maid is a woman who works as a servant in a hotel or in someone's home.

words.ex: He lives in Berlin.
words.ex_cn: 他住在柏林。
words.en: Berlin is the capital and largest city of Germany, known for its historical significance, cultural institutions, and modern architecture.

words.ex: They think highly of their teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他们非常尊敬他们的老师。
words.en: To have a very good opinion of someone or something; to regard someone or something with great respect or admiration.

words.tr: phrase. 约翰·韦伯（人名，常见于德语区姓氏组合）
words.ex: Johann Webber plays the piano every evening.
words.ex_cn: 约翰·韦伯每天晚上弹钢琴。
words.en: A fictional character from the novel 'The Sorcerer's Apprentice' by Paul Gallico, a young boy who learns magic.

words.ex: He wore jeans to the informal party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着牛仔裤去参加非正式的聚会。
words.en: If you describe something as informal, you mean that it is not done or said in a formal or official way.

words.tr:
v. 辩论；争论
n. 辩论；争论
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: A debate is a discussion about a subject on which people have different views.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built the pyramids.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人建造了金字塔。
words.en: Belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence.

words.ex: Two companies compete for the same customers.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司为争夺相同的客户而竞争。
words.en: If you compete with someone for something, you try to get it for yourself and stop the other person getting it. You can also say that two people compete for something that they both want.

words.ex: He beat his competitor in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中击败了对手。
words.en: A competitor is a person, team, or company that is competing against others, especially in business or sports.

words.ex: He will take part in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参加学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To be involved in an activity or event.

words.ex: He won a gold medal in the Olympics.
words.ex_cn: 他在奥运会上赢得了一枚金牌。
words.en: A medal is a small metal disc which is given as an award for bravery or as a prize in a sporting event.

words.tr: phrase. 代表；象征；支持；容忍
words.ex: The letter A stands for apple.
words.ex_cn: 字母A代表苹果。
words.en: If you say that a letter stands for a particular word, you mean that it is an abbreviation for that word.

words.ex: The school mascot is a happy tiger.
words.ex_cn: 学校的吉祥物是一只快乐的老虎。
words.en: A mascot is a person, animal, or object that is adopted by a group as a symbolic figure to bring them good luck.

words.tr: n. 保萨尼亚斯（古希腊地理学家）
words.ex: Pausanias wrote about ancient Greek temples.
words.ex_cn: 保萨尼阿斯写了关于古希腊神庙的内容。
words.en: A Greek traveler and geographer of the 2nd century AD, known for his detailed descriptions of ancient Greek sites.

words.ex: He visited Greece last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了希腊。
words.en: Greece is a country in southeastern Europe with thousands of islands throughout the Aegean and Ionian seas. It's often called the cradle of Western civilization, and Athens, its capital, retains landmarks including the 5th-century B.C. Acropolis citadel with the Parthenon temple.

words.tr:
adj. 希腊的；
n. 希腊语；
words.ex: He loves eating Greek food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吃的希腊食物。
words.en: Relating to Greece, its people, or their language.

words.tr: adj. 奇妙的；魔术的；有魔力的；
words.ex: The magical night lit up the whole village.
words.ex_cn: 奇妙的夜晚照亮了整个村庄。
words.en: Something that is magical seems to use magic or to be full of magic.

words.tr:
n. 志愿者；
v. 自愿做；
words.ex: He is a volunteer at the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地医院的一名志愿者。
words.en: A volunteer is someone who does work without being paid for it, especially work that involves helping people.

words.ex: He returned to his homeland after many years.
words.ex_cn: 多年后，他回到了祖国。
words.en: Your homeland is your native country.

words.tr:
adj. 有规律的；经常的；常见的；
n. 常客；
words.ex: He goes for a run every morning, a regular habit.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步，这是一个有规律的习惯。
words.en: Something that is regular happens or is done at equal intervals or is consistent in pattern or occurrence.

words.ex: The basis of math is numbers.
words.ex_cn: 数学的基础是数字。
words.en: The underlying support or foundation for an idea, argument, or process.

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.ex: He finally admit his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, you agree, often unwillingly, that it is true.

words.ex: The slave worked in the fields every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个奴隶每天在田地里劳作。
words.en: A slave is someone who is the legal property of another person and is forced to obey them.

words.ex: Nowadays, many children use tablets to learn.
words.ex_cn: 现在，许多孩子用平板电脑学习。
words.en: At the present time, in contrast with the past.

words.ex: He practices gymnastics every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上练习体操。
words.en: Gymnastics is a sport that involves exercises and movements that require physical strength, flexibility, balance, and control.

words.tr: n. 体育运动；田径运动；竞技；
words.ex: He loves athletics and runs every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱体育运动，每天早上跑步。
words.en: Athletics refers to sports in general, especially those that involve physical strength, speed, or endurance, such as running, jumping, and throwing.

words.ex: The crowd cheered loudly at the stadium.
words.ex_cn: 观众在体育场里大声欢呼。
words.en: A stadium is a large structure for open-air sports or entertainments, consisting of a field or stage surrounded partly or completely by a tiered structure designed to allow spectators to stand or sit and view the event.

words.ex: They play basketball in the gymnasium.
words.ex_cn: 他们在体育馆打篮球。
words.en: A gymnasium is a large room or building with equipment for exercising the body and increasing strength.

words.ex: He goes to the gym every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身房。
words.en: A gym is a place equipped for physical exercise and training, especially for athletes or for people who want to keep fit.

words.ex: He likes coffee, and he likes tea as well.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，也喜欢茶。
words.en: In addition to something else; also.

words.tr:
n. 主人；主持人；
v. 主持；
words.ex: The host welcomed us with tea and cookies.
words.ex_cn: 主人用茶和饼干欢迎了我们。
words.en: A host is a person who receives or entertains guests, especially in their own home. A host is also a person who presents a television or radio program.

words.ex: He took responsibility for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you have responsibility for something or someone, or if they are your responsibility, it is your job or duty to deal with them and to take decisions relating to them.

words.ex: She eats olive every day with bread.
words.ex_cn: 她每天和面包一起吃橄榄。
words.en: An olive is a small oval fruit with a hard stone and bitter flesh, green when unripe and bluish black when ripe, used as food and as a source of oil.

words.tr: n. 花圈；花环；圈状物；环状物
words.ex: She placed a wreath on the door.
words.ex_cn: 她把花环放在了门上。
words.en: A wreath is an arrangement of flowers, leaves, or stems fastened in a ring and used for decoration or for laying on a grave.

words.ex: He will replace the broken chair.
words.ex_cn: 他将代替这把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: If one thing or person replaces another, the first is used or acts instead of the second.

words.ex: Her motto is 'Never give up.'
words.ex_cn: 她的座右铭是‘永不放弃’。
words.en: A motto is a short sentence or phrase that expresses a rule for sensible behavior, especially a way of behaving in a particular situation.

words.tr:
adj. 迅速的；敏捷的；快的；
n. 雨燕；
words.ex: The swift runner won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位迅速的跑步者赢得了比赛。
words.en: moving or capable of moving at great speed, or happening within a very short time; fast.

words.ex: The similarity between the two paintings is clear.
words.ex_cn: 这两幅画的相似点很明显。
words.en: The quality or state of being similar; likeness or resemblance.

words.ex: He visited Athens last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了雅典。
words.en: The capital city of Greece, known for its historical and cultural significance, especially its ancient monuments and as the cradle of Western civilization.

words.tr:
n. 收费；负责；指控；
v. 收费；充电；
words.ex: The hotel charge is $50 per night.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的收费是每晚50美元。
words.en: If you charge someone, you ask them to pay an amount of money for something that you have sold to them or done for them.

words.ex: He is in charge of the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 他负责管理教室。
words.en: Having the responsibility for something or someone.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.tr:
adj. 很好的；晴朗的；健康的；
n. 罚款；
words.ex: She did a fine job on the project.
words.ex_cn: 她在这个项目上做得很好。
words.en: If you say that something is fine, you mean that it is satisfactory or acceptable.

words.ex: He put up a poster on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张海报贴在墙上。
words.en: A poster is a large notice or picture that you stick on a wall or board, often in order to advertise something.

words.ex: The company will advertise its new phone on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司将在电视上为新手机登广告。
words.en: If you advertise something such as a product, an event, or a job, you tell people about it in newspapers, on television, or on posters in order to encourage them to buy the product, go to the event, or apply for the job.

words.tr: n. 阿塔兰忒（希腊神话中的女猎手）
words.ex: Atalanta was a swift-footed maiden who refused to marry anyone who could not outrun her.
words.ex_cn: 阿塔兰忒是一位脚程极快的少女，她拒绝嫁给任何跑不过她的人。
words.en: Atalanta is a figure from Greek mythology, known as a fierce huntress and a symbol of independence and strength.

words.ex: The princess lived in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 公主住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A princess is a female member of a royal family, especially a daughter or granddaughter of a king and queen, or the wife of a prince.

words.ex: The sun shone with great glory at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 黎明时分，太阳闪耀着辉煌的光辉。
words.en: High renown or honor won by notable achievements; magnificence or great beauty.

words.ex: I found a great bargain at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场上找到了一件便宜货。
words.en: A bargain is an agreement between two people or groups in which each promises to do something in exchange for something else. It can also refer to something bought or offered for sale much more cheaply than is usual or expected.

words.ex: The prince rode a white horse through the castle gate.
words.ex_cn: 王子骑着一匹白马穿过城堡的大门。
words.en: A prince is a male member of a royal family, especially the son of a king or queen.

words.ex: He felt hopeless after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到毫无希望。
words.en: If you feel hopeless, you feel very unhappy because there seems to be no possibility of a better situation or success.

words.tr: n. 希波墨涅斯（希腊神话中的人物，阿塔兰忒的追求者）
words.ex: Hippomenes ran fast to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 希波墨涅斯快速奔跑以赢得比赛。
words.en: In Greek mythology, a hero who won the race for the hand of Atalanta by dropping golden apples to distract her.

words.ex: It was foolish to walk on the ice.
words.ex_cn: 在冰上走是愚蠢的。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is foolish, you mean that they are not sensible or show a lack of good judgment.

words.ex: She dresses like a goddess on Halloween.
words.ex_cn: 她在万圣节打扮得像一位女神。
words.en: A goddess is a female deity. In many cultures, goddesses are associated with Earth, motherhood, love, and the household.

words.ex: He felt great pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到极大的痛苦。
words.en: Pain is the feeling of great discomfort you have, for example when you have been hurt or when you are ill.

words.tr: phrase. 陆续地；一个接一个地
words.ex: The children left the room one after another.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们一个接一个地离开了房间。
words.en: If things happen one after another, they happen in sequence, with little or no time in between.

words.ex: He deserves a break after working so hard.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作后值得休息一下。
words.en: If you say that a person or thing deserves something, you mean that they should have it or receive it because of their actions or qualities.

words.ex: The striker walked out of the factory with other workers.
words.ex_cn: 这位罢工者和其他工人一起离开了工厂。
words.en: A striker is a player in a game such as football whose main purpose is to try to score goals, or a worker who refuses to work as a protest.

words.ex: He uses an abacus to count numbers.
words.ex_cn: 他用算盘来数数。
words.en: An abacus is a frame with rows of wires or grooves along which beads are slid, used for calculating.

words.ex: He uses a calculator to add numbers.
words.ex_cn: 他用计算器来加数字。
words.en: A calculator is a small electronic device that you use for doing mathematical calculations.

words.tr: abbr. 个人计算机；“personal computer”的缩写
words.ex: He uses a pc to do his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他用电脑做作业。
words.en: A PC is a computer that is designed to be used by one person at a time.

words.ex: He uses a personal computer to do his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他用个人电脑做作业。
words.en: A personal computer is a computer that is designed for use by one person at a time.

words.tr: n. 便携式电脑；笔记本电脑；
words.ex: He uses a laptop to work from home.
words.ex_cn: 他用笔记本电脑在家工作。
words.en: A laptop is a computer which is small enough to be carried around easily and is designed for use outside an office.

words.tr: abbr. 掌上电脑；个人数字助理；“personal digital assistant”的缩写
words.ex: He uses a pda to remember his appointments.
words.ex_cn: 他用掌上电脑来记住他的预约。
words.en: A PDA is a handheld device that combines computing, telephone/fax, and networking features.

words.tr: adj. 分析的；善于分析的；
words.ex: He uses analytical skills to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用分析能力解决数学问题。
words.en: An analytical way of doing something involves the use of logical reasoning.

words.ex: He calculates the total cost quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速计算出总成本。
words.en: To determine by mathematical methods; compute.

words.ex: This rule is universal for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则对所有学生都是普遍适用的。
words.en: Something that is universal affects or relates to every part of the world or the universe.

words.ex: He tries to simplify the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他试图简化这个数学问题。
words.en: If you simplify something, you make it easier to understand or you remove the things that make it complex.

words.tr:
n. 金额；总数；
v. 概括；
words.ex: The sum of the bill is fifty dollars.
words.ex_cn: 账单的金额是五十美元。
words.en: A sum is an amount of money, or the total amount of two or more amounts of money added together.

words.tr: phrase. 查尔斯·巴贝奇（英国数学家、发明家，被认为是计算机之父）
words.ex: Charles Babbage designed the first mechanical computer.
words.ex_cn: 查尔斯·巴贝奇设计了第一台机械计算机。
words.en: Charles Babbage was an English mathematician, philosopher, inventor, and mechanical engineer who originated the concept of a digital programmable computer.

words.ex: The operator answered the phone quickly.
words.ex_cn: 接线员迅速接听了电话。
words.en: An operator is a person who operates equipment or a machine, or a person who is in charge of a telephone switchboard.

words.tr: adj. 逻辑上的；合乎逻辑的；
words.ex: His argument is logical and easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点合乎逻辑，容易理解。
words.en: In accordance with the principles of logic; reasonable.

words.tr: adv. 逻辑上；合乎逻辑地；
words.ex: He solved the problem logically.
words.ex_cn: 他逻辑上解决了这个问题。
words.en: In a way that is reasonable and based on good judgment.

words.ex: New technology helps farmers grow more food.
words.ex_cn: 新技术帮助农民种植更多的粮食。
words.en: Technology refers to the application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes, especially in industry.

words.ex: This school has technological labs for students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校为学生配备了科技实验室。
words.en: Technological means relating to or involving technology.

words.ex: The French Revolution changed the government.
words.ex_cn: 法国大革命改变了政府。
words.en: A revolution is a sudden, extreme, or complete change in something, or the act of making such a change.

words.ex: The flowers in the garden are artificial.
words.ex_cn: 花园里的花是人造的。
words.en: Made or produced by human beings rather than occurring naturally, especially as a copy of something natural.

words.ex: He shows high intelligence in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时表现出很高的智力。
words.en: The ability to acquire and apply knowledge and skills.

words.tr: adj. 有才智的；聪明的；明智的；
words.ex: The intelligent boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个有才智的男孩很快解出了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is intelligent has the ability to think, understand, and learn things quickly and well.

words.tr: 专有名词，艾伦·图灵，英国数学家、逻辑学家、计算机科学之父
words.ex: Alan Turing was a brilliant mathematician who helped break codes in World War II.
words.ex_cn: 艾伦·图灵是一位杰出的数学家，曾帮助在二战中破译密码。
words.en: Alan Turing was a British mathematician, logician, cryptanalyst, and computer scientist. He is widely considered to be the father of theoretical computer science and artificial intelligence.

words.ex: He solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解决了这道数学题。
words.en: If you solve a problem or a question, you find a solution or an answer to it.

words.ex: He solved a mathematical problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解决了一个数学问题。
words.en: Relating to or using mathematics; precise and exact.

words.ex: From Monday on, we will have class in the afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 从周一开始，我们将在下午上课。
words.en: From a specified point in time forward; beginning at that time and continuing thereafter.

words.ex: The movie shows a fantasy, not reality.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示的是幻想，而不是现实。
words.en: Reality is the state of things as they actually exist, rather than as they may appear or might be imagined.

words.ex: The designer created a new dress for the show.
words.ex_cn: 这位设计师为这场秀设计了一条新裙子。
words.en: A designer is a person who plans the form, structure, or appearance of something before it is made, by preparing drawings or plans.

words.ex: This is my personal notebook.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的个人笔记本。
words.en: Relating to or belonging to a particular person rather than to a group or an organization.

words.tr: adv. 就本人而言；亲自地；
words.ex: Personally, I like tea more than coffee.
words.ex_cn: 就本人而言，我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you do something personally, you do it yourself rather than letting someone else do it. You can also use personally to show that you are talking about your own opinion or experience.

words.tr: n. [英]地铁；管子；管状物；电视机；
words.ex: I take the tube to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上乘地铁去上班。
words.en: A tube is a long, hollow cylinder used for conveying or holding liquids or gases.

words.tr: n. 晶体管；晶体管收音机
words.ex: The radio uses a small transistor.
words.ex_cn: 这个收音机使用了一个小晶体管。
words.en: A transistor is a semiconductor device used to amplify or switch electronic signals and electrical power.

words.tr:
n. 芯片；
v. 削成碎片；碎裂；
words.ex: The computer chip is very small.
words.ex_cn: 计算机芯片非常小。
words.en: A chip is a small piece which has been broken off something larger, or a small piece of silicon used to make computer parts.

words.ex: He didn't study hard, as a result, he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有努力学习，结果考试不及格。
words.en: used to introduce the consequence or effect of a particular situation or event

words.tr:
adj. 总的；全部的；
n. 总计；总额；
v. 共计；总数达；
words.ex: The total cost is $50.
words.ex_cn: 总费用是50美元。
words.en: The whole amount or number; the sum total.

words.ex: I totally agree with you.
words.ex_cn: 我完全同意你的观点。
words.en: Used to emphasize that something is completely true or correct.

words.ex: He studied hard so that he could pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以便通过考试。
words.en: Used to indicate that something happens to such a degree that something else happens as a result.

words.ex: The internet is a big network of computers.
words.ex_cn: 互联网是一个庞大的计算机网络。
words.en: A network is a system of lines or channels that cross or connect, or a group of broadcasting stations that connect for the simultaneous broadcast of a program.

words.ex: He uses the web to find information.
words.ex_cn: 他使用网络来查找信息。
words.en: A web is a thin net made from sticky threads that a spider uses to catch insects.

words.ex: He submitted his application for the job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周提交了那份工作申请。
words.en: An application is a formal request, often written, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something. It can also refer to the act of putting something to a special use or purpose, or a program or piece of software designed to perform a specific function.

words.tr:
n. 金融；财务；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: He works in finance in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约从事金融工作。
words.en: Finance is the management of large amounts of money, especially by governments or large companies.

words.ex: The mobile table can be moved easily.
words.ex_cn: 这个可移动的桌子很容易搬动。
words.en: A mobile is something that can move or be moved easily.

words.ex: The rocket flew into space.
words.ex_cn: 火箭飞入了太空。
words.en: A rocket is a spacecraft, aircraft, or other vehicle that obtains thrust from a rocket engine.

words.ex: They explore the forest to find hidden caves.
words.ex_cn: 他们探索森林以寻找隐藏的洞穴。
words.en: To explore means to travel over or through an unfamiliar area in order to learn about it or to search for something valuable.

words.ex: The rover is exploring mars.
words.ex_cn: 探测器正在探索火星。
words.en: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun in the Solar System and the second-smallest planet in the Solar System, after Mercury. Named after the Roman god of war, it is often referred to as the 'Red Planet' because the iron oxide prevalent on its surface gives it a reddish appearance.

words.tr: adv. 无论如何；不管怎样
words.ex: I don't like it, but I'll do it anyhow.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢它，但我还是会做。
words.en: in whatever way or manner; regardless of how

words.tr: n. 目标；进球得分；球门；
words.ex: His goal is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: A goal is an aim or purpose that a person or a group of people is trying to achieve.

words.ex: Children find happiness in simple games.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在简单的游戏中找到幸福。
words.en: Happiness is a state of well-being and contentment.

words.tr: phrase. 人类种族；人类整体
words.ex: The human race must protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 人类必须保护环境。
words.en: The human race refers to all the people who live on the Earth, considered as a group.

words.tr: v. 支持；“support”的现在分词； adj. 支持的；
words.ex: He is supporting his friend during the hard time.
words.ex_cn: 他正在支持他的朋友度过艰难时期。
words.en: Providing support or help.

words.ex: I download music from the internet.
words.ex_cn: 我从互联网下载音乐。
words.en: To download data means to transfer it to your computer or device from another computer or from the internet.

words.ex: He is a programmer who writes code for apps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名为应用程序编写代码的程序员。
words.en: A programmer is a person who writes computer programs as a profession or hobby.

words.ex: The virus made many people sick.
words.ex_cn: 这个病毒让很多人病了。
words.en: A virus is a very small organism that causes infectious diseases in people, animals, and plants.

words.ex: The android moved slowly across the room.
words.ex_cn: 那个机器人缓慢地穿过房间。
words.en: An android is a robot or synthetic organism designed to look and act like a human, especially one with a body having a flesh-like resemblance. Also, Android is a mobile operating system developed by Google.

words.tr:
n. 信号；
v. 用信号通知；
words.ex: The traffic light is a signal to stop.
words.ex_cn: 交通灯是一个停止的信号。
words.en: A signal is a gesture, sound, or action which is intended to give a particular message to the person who sees or hears it.

words.ex: My teammate helped me win the game.
words.ex_cn: 我的队友帮我赢得了比赛。
words.en: A teammate is a fellow member of a team.

words.ex: He lives in Nagoya with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他和家人住在名古屋。
words.en: Nagoya is a large city in Japan, known for its manufacturing and as a transportation center.

words.ex: He lives in Seattle.
words.ex_cn: 他住在西雅图。
words.en: A major city in the state of Washington, USA, known for its significant technology industry and cultural landmarks.

words.tr:
n. 类型；种类；典型；字体；
v. 打字；
words.ex: This is a new type of phone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一种新型手机。
words.en: A type is a category of things or people that have similar characteristics.

words.ex: In a way, he is right about the problem.
words.ex_cn: 在某种程度上，他对这个问题的看法是正确的。
words.en: To some extent; from a certain point of view.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.ex_cn: 教练教球队如何获胜。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.ex: A problem arose during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议中出现了一个问题。
words.en: If a situation or problem arises, it begins to exist or people start to become aware of it.

words.ex: He solved the math problem with the help of his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他在老师的帮助下解决了这道数学题。
words.en: With the assistance or support of someone or something.

words.ex: He uses an electronic book to read.
words.ex_cn: 他用电子书来阅读。
words.en: Electronic means relating to devices or systems that operate by controlling the flow of electrons, especially in a vacuum, gas, or semiconductor.

words.tr: n. 外观；外表；出现；露面；
words.ex: The appearance of the house surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的外观让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The way that someone or something looks or the act of coming into view.

words.tr: n. 性格；人物角色；特点；
words.ex: His character is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的性格善良且有耐心。
words.en: The combination of qualities or features that distinguishes one person, group, or thing from another.

words.ex: He had a mop of curly hair that always looked messy.
words.ex_cn: 他有一头乱蓬蓬的卷发，总是看起来很凌乱。
words.en: A mop is a tool for cleaning floors, consisting of a bundle of thick strings or a sponge attached to a long handle. As a verb, it means to clean or wipe something with a mop.

words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能处理困难的问题。
words.en: To deal with something means to take action in order to achieve something or in order to solve a problem.

words.ex: She watches over her little brother at the park.
words.ex_cn: 她在公园里照看她的小弟弟。
words.en: To take care of someone or something, making sure that they are safe and do not get into trouble.

words.ex: The naughty boy broke his mother's vase.
words.ex_cn: 那个顽皮的男孩打碎了他妈妈的花瓶。
words.en: If you say that a child is naughty, you mean that they behave badly or do not do what they are told.

words.ex: My sister's daughter is my niece.
words.ex_cn: 我妹妹的女儿是我的侄女。
words.en: Someone's niece is the daughter of their sister or brother.

words.ex: Parents often spoil their children with too many toys.
words.ex_cn: 父母经常用太多玩具宠坏孩子。
words.en: To spoil something means to reduce its quality or value, often by damaging it in some way. It can also mean to treat someone, especially a child, with too much kindness or indulgence, leading to their detriment.

words.ex: The park protects many kinds of wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护许多种类的野生生物。
words.en: Wildlife refers to animals and plants that live and grow in natural conditions.

words.ex: The helmet gives protection to his head.
words.ex_cn: 头盔保护他的头部。
words.en: Protection is the act of protecting someone or something, or the state of being protected.

words.tr: adj. 野生的；狂热的；荒芜的；猛烈的；
words.ex: The lion is a wild animal.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种野生动物。
words.en: Living or growing in the natural environment; not domesticated or cultivated.

words.tr: n. 栖息地；居留地；产地；
words.ex: The panda's habitat is in the mountains of China.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的栖息地在中国的山区。
words.en: The natural environment in which a species or group of species lives.

words.ex: He threatened to call the police.
words.ex_cn: 他威胁要叫警察。
words.en: If someone threatens to do something unpleasant to you, or if they threaten you, they say or imply that they will do something unpleasant to you, especially if you do not do what they want.

words.tr:
n. 减少；
v. 减少；降低；
words.ex: There was a decrease in rainfall last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月降雨量减少了。
words.en: If something decreases or you decrease it, it becomes less in quantity, size, or intensity.

words.tr: v. 使遭危险或伤害；危害；危及
words.ex: Pollution can endanger animals.
words.ex_cn: 污染会危及动物。
words.en: To put someone or something at risk or in danger.

words.ex: Many old traditions die out over time.
words.ex_cn: 许多古老的传统随着时间推移而消失。
words.en: If something dies out, it becomes less and less common and eventually disappears completely.

words.ex: The company suffered a big loss last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年遭受了巨大损失。
words.en: Loss is the fact of no longer having something or having less of it than you used to have, or the process by which this happens.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.ex: He hunts deer in the forest every autumn.
words.ex_cn: 他每年秋天在森林里打猎。
words.en: To hunt means to chase and try to catch or kill animals for food or sport.

words.ex: This is a no-parking zone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个禁止停车的地带。
words.en: An area or a region distinguished from adjacent parts by a distinctive feature or characteristic.

words.tr: phrase. 平静地；安宁地；和平地；安详地
words.ex: The cat sleeps in peace on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫在沙发上安静地睡觉。
words.en: In a state of harmony or tranquility, without conflict or disturbance.

words.ex: The cat is in danger from the big dog.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫正处在大狗的危险中。
words.en: At risk of harm, injury, or loss.

words.ex: The boy is in danger of falling off the tree.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩有从树上掉下来的危险。
words.en: If someone or something is in danger of something unpleasant happening, they are in a situation where it is possible or likely that it will happen.

words.ex: She picked a white daisy in the field.
words.ex_cn: 她在田野里摘了一朵白色的雏菊。
words.en: A daisy is a small wild flower with white petals and a yellow center.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.ex: He walks on the carpet every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都走在地毯上。
words.en: A carpet is a thick covering of soft material which is laid over a floor or a staircase.

words.ex: He responded to the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: If you respond to something that is done or said, you react to it by doing or saying something yourself.

words.ex: The mountains look distant from here.
words.ex_cn: 从这里看，山显得很远。
words.en: If you describe something as distant, you mean that it is far away in space or time.

words.ex: The coat is made of soft fur.
words.ex_cn: 这件外套是由柔软的毛皮制成的。
words.en: The thick hair that covers the bodies of some animals, or the hair-covered skin(s) of animals, used in making clothes and other items.

words.ex: The antelope runs fast across the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 羚羊在草原上快速奔跑。
words.en: An antelope is a swift-running deer-like mammal with smooth hair and upward-pointing horns, found chiefly in Africa and Asia.

words.tr: n. 津巴布韦（非洲国家）
words.ex: He is from Zimbabwe.
words.ex_cn: 他来自津巴布韦。
words.en: A country in southern Africa, known for its diverse wildlife and landscapes, including the Victoria Falls on the Zambezi River.

words.tr: n. 减缓；宽慰；解脱；救济；
words.ex: The medicine brought relief to his pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药缓解了他的疼痛。
words.en: Relief is a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or distress.

words.tr: phrase. 如释重负地；明显地；浮雕般地
words.ex: He sighed in relief when the exam was over.
words.ex_cn: 考试结束时，他松了一口气。
words.en: A sculptural technique where figures are raised from a flat background, creating a three-dimensional effect on a surface.

words.ex: The children's laughter filled the room.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们的笑声充满了房间。
words.en: The sound of people laughing, especially when it is loud and continuous.

words.tr: 短语动词. 突然大笑起来；放声大笑
words.ex: He burst into laughter when he saw the funny cat.
words.ex_cn: 他看到那只搞笑的猫时大笑起来。
words.en: To suddenly start laughing.

words.ex: The judge showed mercy and let him go free.
words.ex_cn: 法官仁慈地让他自由了。
words.en: If someone in authority shows mercy, they choose not to harm someone they have power over, or they forgive someone they have the right to punish.

words.tr: adj. 某个；确定的；一定的；一定程度上的；
words.ex: I saw a certain man near the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园附近看到某个男人。
words.en: If you are certain about something, you have no doubt about it.

words.ex: The importance of homework is clear.
words.ex_cn: 作业的重要性是显而易见的。
words.en: The quality or state of being important; significance.

words.tr: abbr. 世界野生动物基金（World Wildlife Fund）；
words.ex: The WWF works to protect endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 世界野生动物基金会致力于保护濒危动物。
words.en: The World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF) is an international non-governmental organization founded in 1961, working in the field of wilderness preservation, and the reduction of humanity's footprint on the environment.

words.ex: He rubs his hands together to warm them.
words.ex_cn: 他搓手来暖和它们。
words.en: To move one's hand or a cloth repeatedly back and forth on the surface of something with firm pressure.

words.ex: Wear a hat to protect your face from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 戴帽子以保护你的脸免受阳光照射。
words.en: keep something or someone safe from harm or danger

words.ex: A mosquito bit my arm last night.
words.ex_cn: 一只蚊子昨晚咬了我的胳膊。
words.en: A mosquito is a small flying insect that bites people and animals in order to feed on their blood. Some mosquitoes can transmit diseases.

words.ex: The millipede crawled slowly under the leaf.
words.ex_cn: 千足虫在树叶下缓慢爬行。
words.en: A millipede is a small creature with a long, narrow body and a lot of legs.

words.ex: The insect flew over the grass.
words.ex_cn: 那只昆虫飞过了草地。
words.en: An insect is a small animal that has six legs. Most insects have wings. Ants, flies, butterflies, and beetles are all insects.

words.ex: The box contains five apples.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子包含五个苹果。
words.en: If something such as a box, bag, room, or place contains things, those things are inside it.

words.tr: adj. 强有力的；有影响力的；很有效的；
words.ex: He is a powerful speaker who inspires many.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位强有力的演讲者，激励了很多人。
words.en: A powerful person or thing is able to control or influence people or events.

words.ex: Rain can affect the crop growth.
words.ex_cn: 雨水会影响作物生长。
words.en: To have an influence on or cause a change in someone or something.

words.ex: The child needs attention when he does homework.
words.ex_cn: 孩子做作业时需要被关注。
words.en: Attention is the act of focusing your mind on something and taking notice of it.

words.ex: Please pay attention to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 请专心听老师讲课。
words.en: To focus one's mind or efforts on something or someone, especially in order to understand or learn.

words.ex: I appreciate the beauty of nature.
words.ex_cn: 我欣赏大自然的美。
words.en: If you appreciate something, you recognize its value and feel grateful for it.

words.ex: He worked hard and succeeded in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，考试成功了。
words.en: To achieve something that you have been aiming for, or to take over a position or role after someone else.

words.ex: She lives in Indonesia.
words.ex_cn: 她住在印度尼西亚。
words.en: A country in Southeast Asia, consisting of an archipelago between the Indian Ocean and the Pacific Ocean, known for its diverse cultures, languages, and biodiversity.

words.ex: The rhino is walking in the grass.
words.ex_cn: 犀牛正在草地上行走。
words.en: A rhinoceros, often abbreviated to rhino, is one of any five extant species of odd-toed ungulates in the family Rhinocerotidae, as well as any of the numerous extinct species.

words.tr:
v. （使）获得；
adj. 安全的；稳定的；
words.ex: He worked hard to secure a job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以获得一份工作。
words.en: If you secure something that you want or need, you obtain it, often after a lot of effort.

words.ex: His income is enough to pay for rent and food.
words.ex_cn: 他的收入足以支付房租和食物。
words.en: Income is the money that a person or a company earns regularly, for example from investment or work.

words.ex: The company will employ five new workers next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司下个月将雇佣五名新员工。
words.en: If a person or company employs you, they pay you to work for them.

words.tr:
n. 伤害；损害；
v. 伤害；损害；
words.ex: The storm caused great harm to the crops.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对庄稼造成了很大伤害。
words.en: To harm someone or something means to cause them physical injury or to damage them in some other way.

words.tr: phrase. 麋鹿；四不像（一种原产于中国的大型鹿科动物，角似鹿非鹿、头似马非马、身似驴非驴、蹄似牛非牛）
words.ex: The milu deer live in a protected nature reserve.
words.ex_cn: 麋鹿生活在一处受保护的自然保护区里。
words.en: The milu deer, also known as Père David's deer, is a species of deer that is native to the river valleys of China. It is known for its unique appearance, which includes features of a deer, horse, cow, and donkey.

words.tr:
n. 咬；咬伤；上钩；
v. 咬；叮；上钩；
words.ex: The dog gave him a sudden bite.
words.ex_cn: 狗突然咬了他一口。
words.en: If an animal or person bites you, they use their teeth to cut into your flesh.

words.ex: The extinction of dinosaurs happened millions of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙的灭绝发生在数百万年前。
words.en: The state or process of a species, family, or larger group being or becoming extinct.

words.ex: The child loves to watch dinosaurs on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子喜欢在电视上看恐龙。
words.en: A dinosaur is a type of reptile that lived millions of years ago, known for its large size and often extinct species.

words.ex: The company came into being in 2010.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司成立于2010年。
words.en: To begin to exist or develop.

words.ex: He lives in a small county in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他住在乡村的一个小郡里。
words.en: A county is a region of a country used for administrative or other purposes in certain modern nations.

words.ex: The teacher will inspect our homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会检查我们的作业。
words.en: If you inspect something, you look at it very carefully, usually in order to find out something about it.

words.tr: adj. 想不到的；意料之外的；
words.ex: The rain was unexpected.
words.ex_cn: 这场雨是意想不到的。
words.en: If an event or someone's behaviour is unexpected, it surprises you because you were not expecting it to happen or because you did not think that person would behave in that way.

words.ex: The accident was a serious incident.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是一起严重事件。
words.en: An incident is an event that is either unpleasant or unusual.

words.ex: The worker wore a mask to avoid breathing in dust.
words.ex_cn: 这位工人戴上口罩以避免吸入粉尘。
words.en: Dust is a layer of fine, dry particles on the surface of something, or the fine, dry particles themselves.

words.ex: The results according to the data are surprising.
words.ex_cn: 根据数据，结果令人惊讶。
words.en: In a manner corresponding to something stated or understood.

words.tr: n. 毛里求斯（非洲东部岛国）
words.ex: He lives in Mauritius with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他和家人住在毛里求斯。
words.en: An island country in the Indian Ocean, known for its beaches, lagoons, and reefs.

words.ex: The disappearance of the keys confused everyone.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙的消失让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: The act of disappearing or the state of having disappeared.

words.ex: The fierce lion chased the deer.
words.ex_cn: 那只凶猛的狮子追赶着鹿。
words.en: A fierce animal or person is very aggressive or angry.

words.ex: He studied hard so that he could pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以便通过考试。
words.en: Used to introduce a clause of purpose or result.

words.tr: n. 结束；结局； v. 结束；“end”的现在分词；
words.ex: The ending of the movie was surprising.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的结束令人惊讶。
words.en: The final part of something, especially a story, movie, or play.

words.ex: He faithfully followed his father's advice.
words.ex_cn: 他忠实地遵循了父亲的建议。
words.en: In a manner that is true to the facts or the original; exactly.

words.tr: phrase. 科洛布斯猴（一种生活在非洲的长尾猴，以其黑白相间的毛色和缺乏拇指为特征）
words.ex: The colobus monkey lives in tall trees in Africa.
words.ex_cn: 黑白疣猴生活在非洲的高树上。
words.en: A colobus monkey is a type of Old World monkey known for its long, silky fur and lack of a thumb, found in Africa.

words.ex: He listens to classical music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上听古典音乐。
words.en: Classical refers to music, literature, or art that is considered to be of the highest quality and of lasting value, especially from the ancient Greek or Roman periods or from the 18th and early 19th centuries.

words.tr:
v. 滚动；
n. 滚动；卷形物；
words.ex: The ball roll down the hill.
words.ex_cn: 球从山上滚下来。
words.en: To move somewhere by turning over and over, or to make something move in this way.

words.ex: He loves to listen to rock 'n' roll on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末听摇滚乐。
words.en: Rock 'n' roll is a genre of popular music that originated and evolved in the United States during the late 1940s and early 1950s, primarily from a combination of African American genres such as blues, rhythm and blues, and country music.

words.ex: He plays violin in a local orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个本地管弦乐队中拉小提琴。
words.en: An orchestra is a large group of musicians who play a variety of different instruments together. Orchestras usually play classical music.

words.tr:
n. 说唱乐
v. 说唱；敲击
words.ex: He loves to rap about his life in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢说唱自己在城市里的生活。
words.en: A type of music characterized by rhythmic and/or rhyming speech that is chanted or rapped.

words.tr:
n. 人们；人民；
adj. 民间的；
words.ex: The folk in the village are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 村子里的人们非常友好。
words.en: Folk can refer to people in general, or to a particular group of people. It can also refer to traditional music or customs of a community.

words.ex: He plays jazz on the piano every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上用钢琴演奏爵士乐。
words.en: Jazz is a type of music of black American origin characterized by improvisation, syncopation, and usually a regular or forceful rhythm, emerging at the beginning of the 20th century.

words.tr: adj. 唱诗班的；合唱队的；合唱的
words.ex: The children sing in a choral group.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在一个合唱团里唱歌。
words.en: Relating to a choir or chorus; sung or performed by a choir.

words.tr: phrase. 一支美国1960年代的流行摇滚乐队，以电视情景喜剧形式出道，中文常译为‘猴子乐队’或‘门基乐队’
words.ex: The Monkees played pop music in the 1960s.
words.ex_cn: The Monkees 在1960年代演奏流行音乐。
words.en: The Monkees were an American pop-rock band formed in Los Angeles in 1966. The group was created for a television series of the same name, which aired from 1966 to 1968.

words.ex: He is a musician who plays the guitar.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位弹吉他的音乐家。
words.en: A musician is a person who plays a musical instrument, especially as a profession, or is musically talented.

words.ex: He dreamt of flying like a bird.
words.ex_cn: 他梦见自己像鸟一样飞翔。
words.en: To think about something that you would like to happen or achieve.

words.ex: We sang songs using karaoke at the party.
words.ex_cn: 我们在聚会上用卡拉OK录音唱歌。
words.en: A form of entertainment in which people sing popular songs without the original vocals, typically following the lyrics on a video screen.

words.ex: He pretends to sleep when his mom asks him to clean his room.
words.ex_cn: 当妈妈让他打扫房间时，他假装睡觉。
words.en: If you pretend that something is the case, you act in a way that is intended to make people believe that it is the case, although in fact it is not.

words.ex: To be honest, I don't like this food.
words.ex_cn: 老实说，我不喜欢这种食物。
words.en: used when you are telling someone what you really think

words.ex: Please attach the file to the email.
words.ex_cn: 请将文件附加到邮件中。
words.en: To attach something to something else means to fasten or join it to the other thing.

words.tr: phrase. 附上；连接；认为有（重要性或意义）
words.ex: Please attach the file to the email before sending.
words.ex_cn: 发送前请将文件附加到邮件上。
words.en: To fasten or join something to something else.

words.tr:
n. 形式；表格；形状；
v. 组成；建立；
words.ex: The form of the poem is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的形式非常简单。
words.en: A form is a particular way in which a thing exists or appears, or a document with spaces in which to write information.

words.ex: He became famous for his music and gained great fame.
words.ex_cn: 他因音乐而闻名，获得了巨大的名声。
words.en: the state of being known or talked about by many people, especially on account of notable achievements

words.ex: A passer-by helped the old man cross the street.
words.ex_cn: 一位路人帮老人过马路。
words.en: A passer-by is a person who is walking past something, especially when something unusual is happening.

words.ex: He works hard to earn money.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以赚取收入。
words.en: To earn means to gain something, especially money or respect, through your own efforts or work.

words.tr:
adj. 额外的；
n. 额外的事物；
adv. 额外地；
words.ex: He did extra work to earn more money.
words.ex_cn: 他做了额外的工作来赚更多的钱。
words.en: If something is extra, it is added to an existing amount or number.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful instrument for building.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是建造时有用的工具。
words.en: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular task, especially for scientific, medical, or technical work. It can also refer to a musical instrument.

words.ex: He will perform the task tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会执行这个任务。
words.en: To perform means to carry out, accomplish, or fulfill an action, task, or function. It can also refer to the act of presenting a form of entertainment, such as a play, concert, or other artistic expression, before an audience.

words.ex: His performance in the game was excellent.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的表现非常出色。
words.en: The act of performing a play, concert, or some other form of entertainment.

words.ex: He went to the pub after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后去了酒吧。
words.en: A pub is a building where people can have drinks, especially alcoholic drinks, and talk to their friends. Many pubs also serve food.

words.ex: He paid with cash for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金买了面包。
words.en: Money in the form of coins or banknotes, especially that which is immediately available.

words.tr: phrase. 用现金；以现金方式
words.ex: He paid in cash for the book.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金买了这本书。
words.en: Using physical money rather than a credit card or check.

words.ex: He works in a small studio near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近的一个小工作室工作。
words.en: A studio is a room where an artist, photographer, or designer works, or a place where movies or television programs are made.

words.ex: He became a millionaire after selling his app.
words.ex_cn: 他卖掉自己的应用后成了百万富翁。
words.en: A millionaire is a person whose wealth amounts to a million or more in currency units such as dollars, pounds, or euros.

words.tr: phrase. 开…的玩笑；捉弄；对…搞恶作剧
words.ex: He likes to play jokes on his little brother.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢捉弄他的弟弟。
words.en: To play jokes on someone means to trick them or make them the subject of a joke, often in a playful manner.

words.ex: He is an actor in a famous movie.
words.ex_cn: 他是电影中的一名演员。
words.en: An actor is a person whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.ex: Children rely on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们依靠父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: If you rely on someone or something, you need them and depend on them in order to live or work properly.

words.ex: He relies on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠弟弟帮忙。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.tr:
n. 广播节目；电视节目；
v. 广播；播送；
words.ex: I listened to the morning broadcast on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 我听了早上的广播节目。
words.en: To broadcast is to transmit (a program or some information) by radio or television.

words.ex: He tells humorous stories that make everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他讲一些幽默的故事，让大家都笑。
words.en: If you are humorous, you are able to be amusing and to make people laugh.

words.ex: I am familiar with this song.
words.ex_cn: 我熟悉这首歌。
words.en: If someone or something is familiar to you, you recognize them or know them well.

words.ex: He is familiar with basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他熟悉基础数学。
words.en: If you are familiar with something, you know or understand it well.

words.ex: He is getting familiar with the new software.
words.ex_cn: 他正在熟悉新软件。
words.en: To become acquainted with or gain knowledge of something through study or experience.

words.ex: He is ten years old, or so.
words.ex_cn: 他十岁左右。
words.en: Approximately; used to indicate an estimate or rough quantity.

words.tr: phrase. 打碎；分裂；解体；结束；期终放假
words.ex: He broke up the ice with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子把冰打碎了。
words.en: To end a relationship or to disintegrate into pieces.

words.tr: v. 再结合；再统一；重聚
words.ex: The family will reunite next summer.
words.ex_cn: 这家人将在明年夏天重聚。
words.en: If people are reunited, or if someone reunites them, they meet each other again after they have been separated for some time.

words.ex: She is an attractive woman.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有吸引力的女性。
words.en: An attractive person or thing is pleasing or appealing to look at.

words.ex: The addition of a new chair made the room more comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 增加一把新椅子让房间更舒适了。
words.en: An addition is something that is added to something else, often to improve it or make it larger.

words.ex: He likes apples. In addition, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果。另外，他喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use in addition when you want to mention another item connected with the subject you are discussing.

words.ex: He will sort out his books tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会整理好他的书。
words.en: To sort something out means to organize or arrange it, or to solve a problem or difficulty.

words.ex: The children felt excitement before the birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在生日派对前感到兴奋。
words.en: A feeling of great enthusiasm and eagerness.

words.ex: He sang a old ballad about love and war.
words.ex_cn: 他唱了一首关于爱情与战争的老民谣。
words.en: A ballad is a type of song that tells a story, often a folk song or a slow romantic song.

words.tr:
adv. 在夜里；突然；
adj. 整晚的；
words.ex: The baby slept overnight in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿整夜睡在小床上。
words.en: If something happens overnight, it happens during the night or for the period of one night. It can also mean happening very quickly or suddenly.

words.ex: There was a dip in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额有所下降。
words.en: To dip something means to put it into a liquid and then take it out again.

words.ex: The tadpole swims in the pond.
words.ex_cn: 蝌蚪在池塘里游泳。
words.en: A tadpole is the larval stage in the life cycle of an amphibian, particularly that of a frog or toad.

words.ex: She planted a white lily in her garden.
words.ex_cn: 她在花园里种了一朵白色的百合。
words.en: A lily is a plant with large flowers that are often white, but can also be pink, yellow, or purple. Lilies are commonly used in gardens and as cut flowers.

words.ex: He is confident when he speaks in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在全班面前说话时很自信。
words.en: If you are confident, you are certain of your abilities or of your beliefs.

words.tr: n. 弗雷迪（男子名，Frederick的昵称）
words.ex: Freddy plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 弗雷迪每个周末都踢足球。
words.en: A common male given name, often used informally or as a character name in stories or media.

words.tr:
adj. 简短的；简明的；短暂的；
v. 为…提供信息；
n. 摘要；概要；
words.ex: He gave a brief answer.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了一个简短的答案。
words.en: If something is brief, it lasts only for a short time.

words.ex: He briefly explained the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他简要地解释了这个计划。
words.en: For a short time; in few words.

words.ex: His devotion to his family is obvious.
words.ex_cn: 他对家庭的献身显而易见。
words.en: Devotion is great love, affection, or admiration for someone or something.

words.ex: We had dinner, and afterwards we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 我们吃了晚饭，后来去散步了。
words.en: If you do something or if something happens afterwards, you do it or it happens after a particular event or time that has already been mentioned.

words.ex: He received an invitation to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了参加派对的邀请。
words.en: An invitation is a written or spoken request to come to an event such as a party, a meal, or a meeting.

words.ex: He grew a thick beard last winter.
words.ex_cn: 去年冬天他留了一脸浓密的胡须。
words.en: The hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks.

words.tr: adj. 敏感的；感情脆弱的；体贴的；善解人意的；
words.ex: He is sensitive to loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 他对大声响很敏感。
words.en: If you are sensitive to other people's needs, problems, or feelings, you understand and are aware of them.

words.ex: The cut on his finger is painful.
words.ex_cn: 他手指上的伤口很疼。
words.en: If something is painful, it causes you a lot of physical or emotional pain.

words.ex: Above all, be kind to others.
words.ex_cn: 最重要的是，对他人要善良。
words.en: Most importantly; especially.
